observations.text: Title 'TapNow | Your Agentic Creative Canvas'. Home is a prompt-first launcher: 'What are we making today?' composer (rotating placeholders: 'Organize this project's cre…', 'Help me learn my creative prefere…', 'Try Brainstorm mode to enr…'), then New Project + recent projects, then Skill cards, Arena events, Templates.

'Auto' selector = agent reasoning model: 'Balanced speed, effort, and cost' Recommended Gemini 3.7 Flash; Sonnet 5, GPT 5.6 Sol, GPT 6 Astra, Opus 5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Fable 5, Kimi 2.7/2.6, GPT 5.6 Luna/Terra = 'Unlock with plan'; GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5/3.6 Flash, 3.1 Pro = 'Coming soon'.

Recent project card carries an agent suggestion chip ('Help me carry forward this project's memory' / 'Build a visual story workbench' / 'Connect first and last frames with H3') — memory is a first-class agent concept.

Skill cards: H3 Master Skill, Video Editing, AR, Paper Collage, Motion Design, Music Performance; SD2.5 Master Skills, Second-level Reshoot, Boundless Video Extend, OmniCamera, Omnimodal Subject ('up to 50 references'), Spatial Inpaint. Clicking 'Video Editing' immediately created project 'Video Edit (copy)' and opened its canvas → skills are clonable template projects.
Templates 'Preview' → modal intro (title, description, Input Image / Output, 'Skip intro next time', 'Try Now', Close).
User menu: name, email, Tapies balance (170 after two generations), plan FREE, Create Team, My Portfolio, English, Earn Tapies, My Account, Changelog, Partnership Center, Help Center, Sign Out.
